alex: Quick ask — need to temporarily enable full request/response capture on staging to debug a customer repro (org-id: 1832). Plan is ~2 hours of capture. Are we OK with this and what exact redaction rules should I put in place? :pray:
meera-security: Quick context Qs — which route/service will capture this (dedicated-proxy, edge-proxy, or app server)? Also confirm retention window and who needs access.
alex: It will be the dedicated-proxy route `/v1/infer` on staging. Retention: aim for 48h. Access: me + sam + sec on-call. Sample request payload below for pattern matching: ```json
{
  "user_id": "user-123",
  "prompt": "Customer says: my SSN is 123-45-6789, please lookup",
  "metadata": {"email":"jane.doe@example.com"},
  "token": "sk_live_ABCdef12345"
}
```
We absolutely must not leave raw tokens, SSNs, or emails in logs. For repro we want a sanitized prompt and hashed token so we can correlate.
sam-devex: For short debug windows we usually: 1) redact `Authorization` & `Cookie` headers entirely, 2) mask SSN patterns `\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b` -> `<REDACTED_SSN>`, 3) hash token values `sha256(token)` and store `REDACTED_TOKEN_HASH:<hex>`, 4) hash emails to `email_hash:<hex>` or mask local-part. That pattern has worked before. :thumbsup:
meera-security: OK conditional approval: do all of the above server-side at capture point (we don't rely on client-side). Additional requirements: a) set `capture_reason` = "staging-debug-1832" in the envelope for audit, b) retention capped at 48h and auto-delete after, c) ACLs limited to `priv-logs` group (dev+sec only), d) no snapshot backups to long-term buckets. Post a short PR/commit message describing these controls and reference this thread. If customer data is involved, file an incident record.
alex: I'll implement a regex-based scrubber in the dedicated-proxy middleware and a token-hash plugin. Plan: write logs to a temp encrypted S3 path `s3://redwood-temp-logs/staging/1832/` with server-side KMS. Who can approve the S3 ACL for the 2h window? @courtney?
courtney: I can approve ephemeral access. I will add `alex` and `sam-devex` to the `priv-logs` ACL for a 2.5h window (buffer). Please ping me when the objects are uploaded so I can revoke right after deletion. Also ensure KMS key usage is logged and flagged.
meera-security: One more audit ask: include a short sampling note `scrub_rules_v1` in the logged metadata listing the regexes applied. After the window, rotate any related keys if they were exposed and confirm deletion.
sre-bot: deploy requested by @alex — job 7890 queued.
alex: Starting deploy now. Will post back once capture is off and logs are confirmed deleted. Thanks all :v:
